note: The English site is at /en/. The catalogue (9 consumer cards) and SCB WEALTH by CardX listing (SCB PRIVATE BANKING, SCB FIRST, SCB PRIME) are Next.js pages. Product tiles are not in the first HTML shell; they are in the official RSC payload as productListSection.products (catalogue) and strapiData.products (wealth). The listing object has no official product URL (apply_url is cardx.onelink.me and must not be fetched). list.fields.url records slugName; official detail pages are at /en/credit-card/details/{slugName}. The current recipe runner does not assemble that path automatically, and it cannot yet parse RSC out of the HTML shell. Detail payload fields used on this run: hero_banner.title, product.name, qualification_section. Product sales-sheet PDFs are on cdx-prod-ssc-frontend.cardx.co.th; PoliteFetcher treats that host as not official because official_domains is cardx.co.th with exact-host matching. The site has an English version, so this recipe starts from the English listings only.
